items.p: A low-cost sensor kit reads power, sunlight and wall temperatures every 1–5 minutes. Nothing switches or controls the building.
One wall is shaded by the modules, the other is bare. The difference between them is the cooling effect.
CO₂ uses the UNFCCC grid factor (0.55 t/MWh). Anything we estimate is labelled as an estimate.
